topic: Students and university staff protest Milei's cuts to public university funding and non-implementation of the University Funding Law; Buenos Aires march and one-day UBA faculty-building occupation
scale: As stated in the sources: thousands of university students, staff, trade unionists and opposition activists marched outside parliament; at least 25 arrested after police used tear gas; UBA faculty building occupied for a day
quote1: Students have called an assembly to announce the occupation of the university, a traditional form of protest in Argentina meant to raise public awareness and pressure the government.
quote2: The main demonstration outside parliament by thousands of university students and staff, trade unionists and opposition activists remained peaceful.
